youtube.comment: Requires a YouTube Data API v3 key in the YOUTUBE_API_KEY env var. Add channel IDs you want fully indexed, and/or search terms. Both are used.

podcasts.comment: Add podcast RSS feed URLs. Every episode is pulled; items are kept only if the title/description matches one of the topics (unless keep_all is true for that feed).

websites.comment: Web pages listing talks/articles/videos. Provide a URL and a CSS selector for the links to extract. Leave selector empty to grab all <a> tags on the page.

match.comment: An item is tagged with a topic if any of these regexes (case-insensitive) hit its title or description.
